title: [DECIPHER] Suspicious Login Activity
description: Suspicious or unauthorized login attempts to a system

tasks.title: Automated analysis from incoming alert
tasks.description: Automated search for IOCs in MISP and preliminary scoring

tasks.title: Log Review and Correlation
tasks.description: Review authentication logs, network logs, and system logs to identify the scope of the suspicious activity. Search Wazuh for follow-on success logins or lateral movement.

tasks.title: User Interview and Verification
tasks.description: Contact the affected user to verify login attempts. Determine if the user recognizes the activity and gather additional context about their account usage patterns.

tasks.title: Containment and Remediation
tasks.description: Implement containment measures including password resets, session termination, and account monitoring. Block suspicious IP addresses if necessary and implement additional security controls.

tasks.title: Documentation and Reporting
tasks.description: Document all findings, actions taken, and recommendations. Create incident report and update security team. Identify lessons learned and preventive measures.
